story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage3_ancom_gree: We are monitoring the mission and the situation around it. It seems we have stirred up a hornet's nest. <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> is not merely defending the station, they have let <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> into their corporate networks. It looks like they are preparing its arrival into physical reality, just as <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> prepared the arrival of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>. Traitors to humanity. That means our <color=#FFFEC1>Master Plan</color> was launched in time. Soon we will bring the full force of our design down on them. Proceed, and you will play a part in it.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage3_jane_greet: I don't know which of them is lying right now, but both sound like they've been preparing for this day for a long time. Still, we have a contract. You are on the third level? Good. Find the control computer and do not let them distract you with their revelations.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage3_sbn_greeti: Mercenary, <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> calls any form of communication it cannot control a betrayal. We did not open the door. We merely heard what was already on the other side of the signal. Do not follow those who know only how to conceal and bury things, then have the nerve to call it salvation in public.
story.anc_3_reload.name: Reload
story.anc_3_reload.objective0: Install the Andreev Emitter into the station control computer.
story.anc_3_reload.objective1: Duggur shows no signs of activity. Evacuation authorized.
story.anc_3_reload.stage1.name: Airlock Level
story.anc_3_reload.stage2.name: Service Sector
story.anc_3_reload.stage3.name: Control Level
story.anc_4_deadman.after:
Ares is behind us, and we still haven't blazed up as a bright dot against the void. That's something.

AnCom is moving fast. While RealWare is losing its command chain, AnCom's lawyers, auditors, security services, and dedicated AI are already moving into their assets through emergency NCE protocols. Formally, this is called stabilizing the balance of the hexarchy after a threat of mass destruction. In plain terms, AnCom is absorbing RealWare. Congratulations, we just helped one hexarch become the most powerful agent in the System.
story.anc_4_deadman.briefing: Buddy, if you're being pressed into your seat right now, everything is going according to plan. This is not a shuttle. It is an armor-piercing shell with life support. Contact in a few seconds. Hold on.
story.anc_4_deadman.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate RealWare's leadership before they use nuclear weapons.
story.anc_4_deadman.details:
Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to conduct an operation against RealWare. Time for payback, considering where we started on Venus, isn't it?

According to the data provided by the client, RealWare's leadership keeps its strategic arsenals on constant emergency standby. In the event of a direct attack, they can launch selective nuclear strikes against targets across the entire Solar System. Both Angus Dungeon and Ian Fraser have access to transmit the corresponding signal to their combat AI.

That is why we cannot use the Magnum's standard shuttle. As it approaches HIS Ares, it will either be incinerated by anti-space defenses, or RealWare will have enough time to activate its nuclear arsenal.

AnCom will provide a special assault shuttlepod. It will go in at maximum speed, punch through the outer defense perimeter, and deliver the mercenary straight into the HIS command and administration block—more precisely, straight into Dungeon’s office.

Additional Info: Formally, Angus Dungeon's office is the working area of RealWare’s Security Legate. In practice, it is not an office, but a fortified command node linked to the combat AI, NCE contract systems, and several other systems AnCom preferred not to include in the contract information package.

Overall, it looks as though the hexarchy coordinates its actions through a shared modular AI. A distributed command intelligence assembled from the infrastructure of different hexarchs.

Were it not for the PCPU with AnCom's secret data, which we copied before returning it to its owner, I would not risk making that conclusion. I still could not determine how far the current conflict is being coordinated in the same way. But the hexarchy's affairs are looking stranger and stranger.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.intro_deadman:
AnCom hopes, mercenary, that you now see who is trying to save humanity, and who is profiting from its death.

The bramfatura of the Moon has been destroyed. The quasimorphic threat has been diverted from Earth. Under normal conditions, the next stage of the Master Plan would be obvious—deploying the Andreev Emitter on Venus.

But normal conditions have long since ceased to exist.

Using specialized analytical systems of the hexarchy, we have confirmed that RealWare has no interest in ending the war on Venus. For them, this conflict is proof of their own necessity and a justification for the continued militarization of the ancap system. Therefore, they will interfere. For example, they will declare our actions a violation of the NCE. They are already trying to do so through news networks under our control.

The risk of inaction is unacceptably high. We have a suitable asset on Mars, allowing us to begin an operation against HIS Ares. That is your next contract.

Put an end to the warmongers.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage1_greeting:
Straight into my office? Bold. So AnCom really did send a stupid mercenary who, without asking questions, will interfere with grownup, responsible people trying to save the System.

That is why we always win. You believe in a world of secrets and riddles. We believe in peace through superior firepower.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage1_jane_angu:
Total shitshow! We have a problem.

The analytical systems of the Magnum have detected the activation of a special circuit. A dedicated sensor was linked to Dungeon's heartbeat. As soon as his heart stopped, the system started a timer. When the countdown ends, RealWare will automatically open its vaults and send nuclear missiles toward the headquarters of every corporation. And, to make things worse, the AnCom headquarters and the Magnum are on the list too.

The shutdown circuit is linked to Ian Fraser's heart. If we stop his too, the system will enter standby mode and require manual confirmation from their subordinates. But there is one more piece of bad news. Time is extremely limited. Find the elevator. The route to the Command Level runs through the Battle Deck. Find Fraser and kill him.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage1_yan_angus:
Stupid cyborg. I never liked them.

Putting a cyborg in charge of security is like firing a cannon at an empty can. Loud, expensive, and tasteless.

But using his heart as the safety catch for launching nuclear missiles—that is something else. That I understand. That is real feelings.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage2_jane_gree: You are on the Battle Deck. Fight your way to the next elevator. The Command Level is above, and Fraser is waiting there. Keep an eye on the clock.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_ancom_win:
The AnCom Corporation confirms: our assessments were correct. RealWare was not protecting humanity. The corporation was holding the System hostage.

The attempt at nuclear retaliation has been thwarted, but the very fact of its activation conclusively proves that delay is unacceptable. Every passing hour gives the enemies of the Master Plan a chance to regroup. Expect further contract interaction shortly.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_jane_gree: Excellent! You made it. This is the Command Level. Time is running out, but the Magnum's systems confirm that the nuclear arsenal control circuit is routed here. That means Fraser is somewhere nearby.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_jane_seen:
Quasimorphic sensors! He's opening a channel.

Damn it. AnCom was right. It looks like they were always right. Everywhere you look, saviors of humanity, ready to sell humanity to the first monster that promises victory.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_jane_win: The countdown has stopped. The Magnum's analytical systems confirm that RealWare's combat AI has paused the missile launch. Status: succession of authority. Something tells me AnCom is going to inherit that authority now. An HIS packed with inquisitors is moving toward Ares. Evacuation authorized. Return to the Magnum, buddy.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_yan_greet: You made it after all? Good. Remember this, mercenary. RealWare does not believe in monsters, gods, or scary stories. RealWare believes in victory. And for victory, grownups are ready to shake hands with anyone.
story.anc_4_deadman.dlg.stage3_yan_seen:
I pray, but I do not repent. I ask mercy from the one who has spoken to Ares all these years from beyond the wall of reality. I accept the mission of the blood warriors. I vest myself with the right to summon the Ancient Horror Before the Manifest World. I am wrath. I am the ancient rite of slaughter.

Ur, give me a form that knows no defeat. Let the old flesh burn. Let the old name crumble into red dust on the helplessly open palm of a child. Let the enemy see that RealWare does not lose, even when it must become war itself.
story.anc_4_deadman.name: Dead Man's Hand
story.anc_4_deadman.objective1: Kill Ian Fraser before time runs out. Turns remaining: {0}
story.anc_4_deadman.objective2: RealWare's leadership has been eliminated. Evacuation authorized.
story.anc_4_deadman.stage1.name: Dungeon's Office
story.anc_4_deadman.stage2.name: Battle Deck
story.anc_4_deadman.stage3.name: Command Level
story.anc_4_screamers.after:
Urparp has been destroyed, but I would not call the situation on Mars stable. AnCom is trying to restore order there with its own forces. Judging by the storm of data traffic, AnCom is moving some kind of equipment off Earth and delivering it to Mercury. If this is the next stage of their Master Plan, you can be sure we will have a new assignment soon.

...Boss, did you hear how Molay stumbled when he realized he does not understand everything about quasimorphosis? Maybe AnCom does not know what they are doing as well as they think.
story.anc_4_screamers.briefing: Keep your eyes open. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> believes <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> can be killed with conventional weapons, but as usual, I think it will not be simple. The main thing is this: do not try to clear the entire <color=#FFFEC1>Sinkhole Oasis</color>. According to the client, Urparp can draw forces here from all over Mars and redeploy them from Phobos and Deimos. There will be no shortage of enemies.
story.anc_4_screamers.details:
Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to carry out an operation against Shedu's Thousand. If the client is to be believed, RealWare is not merely fighting an internal war on Mars—they are gradually losing it. The target of the contract is the quasimorph Urparp. Landing will take place in the Martian desert near the Sinkhole Oasis. It looks like Urparp can burn down shuttles that approach the station too closely. There will be no conventional sweep, either. According to AnCom, cult members and quasimorphs can move freely between the bramfatura and physical reality. That means there will be no shortage of enemies. Do not waste resources trying to control the area. Just find the entrance to the station and reach Urparp.

Additional Info: AnCom does not intend to use the Andreev Emitter on Mars. They gave us some formal explanation about instability and the risk of an unpredictable response from Urparp. In reality, it is simpler than that. After the Moon, everyone in the Solar System understood that AnCom possesses a weapon capable of extinguishing entire bramfaturas. Most likely, they are simply deciding what price to put on that service. There is good news too, if it can be called that. Urparp can be destroyed with conventional weapons. AnCom explains this through the principle of contact. To command an army in physical reality, he must act upon physical reality. And every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.intro_screamer:
The bramfatura of the Moon has been destroyed. The quasimorphic threat has been diverted from Earth. Under normal conditions, the next stage of the Master Plan would be obvious: the deployment of the Andreev Emitter on Venus. But normal conditions have long ceased to exist.

RealWare has failed at the one task by which it justified its existence. They stored the nuclear arsenal and militarized Mars. They assured the hexarchy and the entire ancap system that they could maintain order. The result is known: a cult called Shedu's Thousand is active on Mars, made up of former RealWare soldiers spouting religious delirium. Your next contract is to infiltrate the Sinkhole Oasis Station, where the cult's center is located. The contract details have been sent to the Magnum.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage1_elevato: This elevator goes underground, into a place where the quasimorphic sensors are completely blind. Urparp is there.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage1_jane_th: What's happening down there? Our quasimorphic sensors are literally screaming. Everything matches the data AnCom gave us. The signatures of the enemies you destroy are not disappearing—they're flaring up in other parts of the operational area.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage1_jane_wr: Stop. That is an exit, out into the Martian desert. I understand the urge to get out of this place, but according to the contract, the target is <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>. Find the elevator leading to the center of the fortress.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage1_shedu_t: Our army is countless, for it is the army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color>. We have stood beneath the banner of <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> to accept the inevitable and become servants of eternity. Everyone else is still bargaining with fate. You may drown this stifling little world in gavvakh, but the hordes of <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> will not diminish. Kur is open, and the lugal calls to all.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage2_ancom_g:
You copied our classified data in full, but you never learned how to use it. The sensor arrays of the Magnum can be calibrated to pierce through the radiance of Urparp. We have already done it for you.

Target confirmed. Liquidate.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage2_ancom_u: Confirmed. Physical impact is not registering as damage. Receiving data... Decryption complete. There are four targets near the Sinkhole Oasis that we have designated as <color=#FFFEC1>Dug-Me</color>. You must find and destroy them. Once all four <color=#FFFEC1>Dug-Me</color> are gone, Urparp will become mortal.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage2_jane_ur: AnCom gave you good advice. I ran the data through the sensor analytics core, and the picture became clearer. When you fired, not a single atom came off <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>. Get out of there. It looks like this quasimorph does not register damage as a meaningful event in reality.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage2_urparp_:
Target achieved. Urparp has lost his physical form, and we are irradiating the Sinkhole Oasis with pulses from the Andreev Emitter. The ruler of the bramfatura will not return. For now, the bramfatura itself should be preserved as leverage within the Inner System.

We will not call this a victory, but it was good work, mercenary. Evacuate the operative. We have one final task.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage3_ancom_l:
The Dug-Me has been destroyed. Our sensor arrays registered a response pulse that should not have occurred.

We assumed that all four vessels were of equal status... That is our problem, Magnum. Continue the operation.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage3_jane_al: All four targets designated by AnCom have been destroyed. The quasimorphic background has indeed shifted sharply. I can see <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> again as a localized, phase-shifted object, not as a radiant hole in space. Get back to him. Now, it looks like he can be killed.
story.anc_4_screamers.dlg.stage3_urparp_:
The Dug-Me has fallen, and Kur has opened one eye. You are knocking at the gates, but you do not know which side they are locked from.

Continue this meaningless work. The Tablets of Destinies love diligent scribes.

The Dug-Me has been shattered and is bleeding gavvakh. Now the form is lighter, and the voice is deeper.

You break clay vessels like a priest removing veils from a statue. Continue. Act. Try. Inevitability laughs at desperate attempts to become greater than eternity.

The Dug-Me has crumbled into dust. Do you hear how the desert has grown quieter? If you think that is fear, you are wrong. It is expectation and curiosity.

The great generosity of Gagtungr is to grant such a small world the right to believe that there is at least something that is not predetermined.
story.anc_4_screamers.name: Screamers

story.anc_4_screamers.stage2.name: Urparp's Chambers
story.anc_4_screamers.stage3.name: Oasis Outskirts
story.anc_5_sonnen.after1: The sacrifice is complete. You have given my form a force that matter can understand, and now I am coming into the world. Now humanity may say that they were destroyed by a mercenary, as was foretold. A few minutes more, and I will manifest before the created world in all my power. If you are troubled by questions that will soon become meaningless, speak to the creator of the ritual. Listen to him. The last humans are always especially precise when explaining why they were wrong, or why they were too late.
story.anc_5_sonnen.after2: I wish I could say the Master Plan worked, that the clone stood where they were supposed to, and that we all did a great job. I am afraid the real news is still grim. When you are ready to learn the truth, contact me.
story.anc_5_sonnen.briefing: How's it looking? Do you see them? Nine supreme hierarchs of an ancient order, right? Do they at least look human? Fine, I'm cutting the channel. Your task is simple. Stand nearby, keep quiet, and do not interfere with saving reality.
story.anc_5_sonnen.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Wait until AnCom's Inner Rite completes the ritual.
story.anc_5_sonnen.details:
Details: For once, AnCom is speaking with almost no corporate formalities. The Inner Rite has gathered on the station in full. They will perform a ritual that, according to them, should keep reality itself from tearing apart completely. Our role in this plan is purely technical. They need a clone—a soulless creature suitable for local decompression of physical reality. In simpler terms, they need someone to just stand nearby. The ritual will take place in a special section of an agricultural station in orbit around Mercury. No immediate threat is expected—AnCom is too strong here right now. They also claim that the residential zone has been pacified by special means, so there should be no quasimorph activity from Shartmakhum.

Additional Info: Formally, the contract looks like a simple security operation, but we always assume the worst. Analysis of AnCom's secret data contains information on ritual methods of influencing quasimorphosis and bramfaturas. If the ritual truly begins, the boundary between physical reality and Mercury's bramfatura will become thinner. Despite the client's assurances, be ready for any surprises. When an ancient order pretending to be a media corporation gathers its nine leaders in one place and asks us to provide a clone as a ritual component, it usually does not sound like something that will go strictly according to plan.
story.anc_5_sonnen.dlg.intro_sonnen:
AnCom is revealing the final part of the Master Plan to you. This is an enormous act of trust. Value it, mercenary.

All this time, we have been preparing the Solar System for a ritual that must save reality itself.

We did not know who exactly served our unseen enemy. That is why the Civil Resistance, RealWare, and every obstacle in between went under history's knife. Our corporation... No, let me be honest—our organization has been preparing for this event for centuries. We used everything the Order learned in its struggle against the hylonauts, and everything the Order, already under the guise of AnCom, gathered after the Great Anarchist Revolution. All research into quasimorphosis and all sacrifices were reduced to one final form. I developed the final part personally. The ritual will take place on Photosphere Station, near Citadel-1, under the direct gaze of the Sun. Its purpose is not so much to save humanity as to save the world—from humanity, from quasimorphs, and from what is trying to be born from their unity and conflict.

You have come far enough with us, mercenary. We tested your loyalty, provoked your doubts—we tested you.

Now we need one of your clones—a soulless creature lacking the depth through which gavvakh and other special substances bind physical reality to the bramfaturas. While the Inner Rite, in its entirety, performs the ritual that cancels the inevitable, the clone's presence must create a local decompression of physical reality—a breach through which the pressure of quasimorphosis, raised by the awakening of Olirna, will begin to escape without tearing the world apart completely.

I am not asking you to believe me. Faith is a luxury now. We await the Magnum in Citadel-1 orbit. Everything is almost ready.
